```{r pass_fail_pctError, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# 1. Summarise transaction execution status by run
status_df <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    success_clean = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))),
    success = success_clean %in% c("true", "yes") | success == TRUE
  ) %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_tx = n(),
    pass_tx  = sum(success, na.rm = TRUE),
    fail_tx  = sum(!success, na.rm = TRUE),
    error_rate = if_else(total_tx > 0, (fail_tx / total_tx) * 100, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(run_id)

if (nrow(status_df) > 0) {
  
  # 2. Build the three-card template block with clean backticks and single-escaped newlines
  ticks <- "```"
  box_template <- paste0(
    "### %s Passed\n\n",
    ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
    "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
    "  value   = '%s',\n",
    "  caption = '%s',\n",
    "  icon    = 'fa-check-circle',\n",
    "  color   = '%s'\n",
    ")\n",
    ticks, "\n\n",
    "### %s Failed\n\n",
    ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
    "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
    "  value   = '%s',\n",
    "  caption = '%s',\n",
    "  icon    = 'fa-times-circle',\n",
    "  color   = '%s'\n",
    ")\n",
    ticks, "\n\n",
    "### %s Error Rate\n\n",
    ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
    "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
    "  value   = '%s',\n",
    "  caption = '%s',\n",
    "  icon    = 'fa-exclamation-triangle',\n",
    "  color   = '%s'\n",
    ")\n",
    ticks, "\n"
  )
  
  # 3. Format and compile dynamic triplet cards for each run sequentially
  src <- pmap_chr(status_df, function(run_id, pass_tx, fail_tx, error_rate, ...) {
    # Formatted Pass Box metrics
    pass_display <- format(pass_tx, big.mark = ",")
    pass_caption <- sprintf("<strong>Passed Transactions</strong>")
    
    # Formatted Fail Box metrics
    fail_display <- format(fail_tx, big.mark = ",")
    fail_caption <- sprintf("<strong>Failed Transactions</strong>")
    
    # Formatted Error Box metrics
    error_display <- paste0(format(round(error_rate, 2), nsmall = 2), " %")
    error_caption <- sprintf("<strong>Error Rate</strong>")
    
    # Map all 12 placeholders into the clean templates
    sprintf(box_template, 
            run_id, pass_display, pass_caption, passedGreen,
            run_id, fail_display, fail_caption, failedRed,
            run_id, error_display, error_caption, planitOrange)
  })
  
  cat(knit(text = paste(src, collapse = "\n"), quiet = TRUE))
}
